name: Ividine
source:
Race: Male demon
Origin: Abandoned Desert
Hobby: Business, Cosplay
Job: Prince, Businessman

Orem’s and Yumbrad’s mysterious oldest brother, currently Ividine is one of Chippy Company’s businessmen. In OASE, Ividine can be found in the Exhibition Hall with Kocha.
